title: Verify Service Advisor is blocked from deleting a payment while Manage AP/AR is OFF
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Service Advisor role. (this role has Invoicing and Payments: Delete, but Manage Accounts Payable and Receivable is OFF; per spec v33 / SV-7913, Invoicing Delete additionally requires Manage AP/AR ON - this blocking is intended, not a bug).
Note: the role may display as 'Junior Service Advisor' in the build (the spec calls it 'Service Advisor').
The work order already has an invoice created on its Finance tab.
A payment has been recorded against the invoice.
steps:
1. Open the work order's Finance tab and locate the payment.
2. Try to delete the payment.
expected: Deleting the payment is BLOCKED (a configuration prompt or permission block appears) because Manage AP/AR is OFF, even though the role has Invoicing Delete. This is the intended behavior per SV-7913.
